criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: 6 arXiv evidence-source URLs cited but not independently verifiable from supplied evidence
8 artefacts omitted including representation_plan, run_manifest, dataset_manifest; representation_plan omission is notable given inline representation priorities

Augmentation set (vflip, rotate90) deviates from research-recommended conservative set (hflip, ±10° rotation, ±2px translation); vflip and rotate90 may disrupt tissue-orientation cues in pathology images
Augmentation set includes vflip and rotate90, which are aggressive for histopathology orientation cues; research-recommended conservative set (hflip, ±10° rotation, ±2px translation) was not used
Baseline tiny_cnn config contains transformer-specific fields (num_heads, patch_size, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers, pooling, positional_encoding); config hygiene issue for reproducibility
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) test recall is only 49.4 % (208/421), driving most of the accuracy loss; the headline accuracy comparison masks this per-class weakness
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) test recall is only 49.4% (208/421), with 94 misclassified as debris and 75 as smooth muscle; this single class drives most of the accuracy loss
Class 7 test recall is only 49.4 % (208/421); the headline accuracy comparison masks this per-class weakness; report should include macro-F1 or balanced-accuracy deltas and per-class breakdown

Comparison report declares primary_metric=accuracy and reports only the accuracy delta; a macro-F1 or balanced-accuracy delta would better reflect the per-class variance (class 7 F1=0.612 vs class 3 F1=0.967)
Early-stopping patience is 3 in final training but 5 in the corresponding search trial; discrepancy noted for reproducibility
Early-stopping patience of 3 is well below the research-recommended 10–15; with a 15-epoch budget this risks premature stopping at epoch 12
